questions.question: Which description fits the **Flag** resource?
options: Prospective warnings of potential issues when providing care to the patient.
An association between a patient and an organization / healthcare provider(s) during which time encounters may occur.
This resource is a general-purpose container for knowledge asset definitions.
An interaction between a patient and healthcare provider(s) for the purpose of providing healthcare service(s) or assessing the health status of a patient.
questions.explanation: **Flag**: Prospective warnings of potential issues when providing care to the patient. The other descriptions belong to **EpisodeOfCare**, **Library**, **Encounter**.

questions.question: Which resource would you use? Show a warning banner on the patient’s record: “Risk of violence: do not visit alone”.
questions.explanation: **Flag**. A prospective alert for anyone looking at the record.

questions.question: You know **Flag**. Which resource should you use instead when you need “a problem found by a clinical check”?
questions.explanation: **DetectedIssue**: a problem found by a clinical check. **Flag** is for something else: Prospective warnings of potential issues when providing care to the patient.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **Flag** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of Flag are `status` (1..1), `code` (1..1), `subject` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **Flag** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of Flag: `status`. `status`: active | inactive | entered-in-error. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
